title: Tomb of Thutmose II announced over a year after discovery

tellings.quote: When I was there in October, I heard about that tomb uh having been discovered earlier in 2024.

plain: The tomb of Thutmose II, an ancient Egyptian pharaoh, was supposedly found in early 2024 but only announced to the public more than a year later. Luke Caverns, a researcher who explores ancient sites, tells Michels that when he was in Egypt in October 2024 he "heard about that tomb having been discovered earlier in 2024." He tells it to suggest that big finds can sit unannounced for a long time.
